name: steward-review
title: workstation-steward: the weekly review
desc: An illustrative steward review, looping. Eight read-only stages run (soak, supply-chain audit, AI tooling, projects, your config repo, the release-age gate, the fleet), then one report lists four items to decide, each under the command that acts on it: prune now that the soak has ended, and two Homebrew updates past the release-age gate under the one command they share. Then what the gate holds back in Renovate's Dependency Dashboard: a TypeScript update that has cleared, so Renovate opens its PR, and a Node release that clears later that day, with the steward sc node-patch to run after its merge. Nothing is changed.

segs: [5/8] projects behind the AI tools: off
[6/8] your config repo: 0 to do here, 0 PR(s), 0 decision(s)
[8/8] fleet on GitHub: 0 of 9 repos with something open

- the soak has ended: old installs can be pruned

segs: DRY_RUN=1 steward sc prune, then steward sc prune
steward sc plan, then steward sc upgrade
